### How Jesus Responds to Our Anxiety - The Crosswalk Devotional - April 19
Author: Jennifer Slattery
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/how-jesus-responds-to-our-anxiety-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: John 14:1
Points:
- Christ offers comforting reassurance rather than guilt or condemnation to troubled hearts.
- Peace is not achieved through frantic self-effort but received as a gift from Jesus.
- The disciples faced painful upcoming losses, prompting Jesus to urge them to trust Him.
- Lingering anxiety diminishes as believers intentionally renew their minds and walk closely with Him.

### Let Not Your Hearts Be Troubled
Author: Donald Macleod
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/let-not-your-hearts-be-troubled
Passage: John 14:1
Points:
- Jesus aimed His comforting words directly at the foreboding confusion His disciples were experiencing.
- Christ urged faith in Himself alongside the Father, trusting God's purpose behind imminent dark events.
- By going through the cross and resurrection, Jesus secured a dwelling place for His people.
- The ultimate comfort of heaven is being permanently welcomed into the personal presence of Jesus.
